turns.replyText:
Today
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m really sorry this happened; I know that’s frustrating after you’ve been waiting on your plants.
To help the team review this, please reply with everything below in one go:
Your full name
Your email address (the one used to place the order)
Your order number (if you have it handy) or your shipping address
The names of the damaged items
A brief description of what you’re seeing
Photos of the box and the damaged item(s), if you’re able to upload them here
Once you send that over, I’ll make sure all of this gets in front of the right person. I have routed you to one of my colleagues, who will be happy to assist. Be on the lookout for an email from them soon!

Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return. Plants purchased directly through Heirloom are not returnable, and damaged items are reviewed separately.

Please send your email address or order number so the team can look into it for you.
